svg.title: ThingsBoard 3.6.4 - Device delete: database transaction, pre-commit queues and runtime cleanup

g.text: ThingsBoard 3.6.4 - Device delete: database transaction, pre-commit queues and runtime cleanup
[not Tenant Admin, not found, or permission denied]
ROLLBACK all Alarm and Device work
Default AFTER_COMMIT listeners do not run.
No Device cluster notification was sent yet.
async INSERT audit_log in independent transaction
returns without waiting Queue or Audit
Messages already accepted or consumed are not recalled.
Session/Actor/State may observe delete while Device remains.
Relation and Alarm Type cache keys
If no actor existed, deletion may create
one briefly just to process the stop command.
Device deletion does not call AttributeService or TimeseriesService.
attribute_kv, ts_kv, ts_kv_latest, Cassandra telemetry and per-device RPC rows remain.
